reviews.comment: Professor Graham is an amazing professor. Her class is fairly easy and provides small activities response that are worth 2 points so it boost your grade a bit. there is one group project which is not hard either.  ONLY thing is that her exams are quite challenging if you dont review class lectures. she only does 2 exams. the midterm and the final
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I think this professor has been one of my favorite at A&M so far, you can tell she really cares about the content she teaches and is very caring of her students as well. She was always available when needed, answered every question and made sure everyones opinions were heard and respected. She's an awesome professor and there isn't a big workload.

SOCI Mental Health. Easy class, she said everyone got a 100 on our group presentations. Attendance is basically mandatory with in class activities, but its just participation. She was flexible with extensions for papers (2-3 pages, 4 of them total). 2 exams, and she gives a study guide for them. Overall super sweet and I recommend to everyone!

She is one of the best professors i have had at A&M. She is extremely nice and very easy to talk to. lectures are pretty straight forward and her test are based on the lectures and some readings. There is one group project at the end of the semester and 4 papers along the way. I would take her again if i could, great professor!
